hero.lead: An island nation of 1.24 million with $10.3 billion of reserves, which has set itself a legal anchor to bring public debt of 87.8% of GDP down to 75% by 2030.

items.text: Reserves worth about two thirds of a year’s output: a base for long-term finance in local currency.

items.text: Cane fields that built the economy, ready to be priced as land, energy and food.
